text: The US Minor Outlying Islands are a chain of islands that are US overseas territories. As such, it is counted as **the US** for country streak purposes.
The guide will be somewhat skewed towards the Midway Atoll, as that is the only island with pinpointable coverage.
NOTE: The easiest way to locate the Midway Atoll on the map is to zoom in slightly to the west of the North Pacific Ocean map label.
text_zh: 美國本土外小島是一連串屬於美國海外領土的島嶼。因此，就連勝紀錄（country streak）而言，它被算作**美國**。
本指南將稍微偏向中途島（Midway Atoll），因為那是唯一有精確定位街景的島嶼。
注意：在地圖上定位中途島最簡單的方法是稍微放大北太平洋（North Pacific Ocean）地圖標籤的西側。

text: The coverage on the Midway Atoll was made with a **Generation 2 camera**.
text_zh: 中途島上的街景是用**第二代相機**拍攝的。

text: One of the most distinct features of the Midway atoll is the presence of multiple **albatrosses** on almost every single location.
text_zh: 中途島最明顯的特徵之一，幾乎在每一個地點都能看到多隻**信天翁**。

text: A large part of the coverage on the Midway Atoll was taken on two **runways**, which are the only areas where it can be difficult to spot the albatrosses.
text_zh: 中途島的大部分街景都是在兩條**跑道**上拍攝的，這是唯一可能很難發現信天翁的區域。

text: The islands other than the Midway Atoll can generally be characterised by three things. Firstly, the **Generation 3 trekker** coverage. Secondly, the low, **bushy** vegetation, and thirdly, the presence of numerous **birds**.
text_zh: 除了中途島之外，其他島嶼通常可以用三件事來特徵化。首先是**第三代徒步拍攝**街景。其次是低矮、**多叢的**植被，第三則是存在著大量的**鳥類**。

text: A **nicely paved runway** can be seen going west to east on the southern side of the Midway Atoll.
text_zh: 在中途島南側可以看到一條**鋪設良好的跑道**由西向東延伸。

text: A **poorly paved runway** can be seen going north to south on the Midway Atoll. The pavement gets increasingly poor to the [north](https://goo.gl/maps/d45BgC8WQFuxeAE67).
text_zh: 在中途島可以看到一條**鋪設不良的跑道**由北向南延伸。路面越往[北](https://goo.gl/maps/d45BgC8WQFuxeAE67)越糟糕。

text: On the eastern side of the Midway Atoll, you can find a **small village**.
text_zh: 在中途島的東側，你可以找到一個**小村莊**。

text: Southeast Island is arguably the least distinctive island in the chain. It has a small lake near the centre, and a large amount of birds in the sky.
text_zh: 東南島（Southeast Island）可以說是這一連串島嶼中最沒有特色的島嶼。它在中心附近有一個小湖，天空中則有大量的鳥類。

text: Lisianski Island only has coverage right by the shore and can typically be recognised by the **large bushes** going around the entire island.
text_zh: 利相斯基島（Lisianski Island）只有緊鄰海岸的街景，通常可以透過環繞整座島嶼的**大型灌木叢**來辨識。

text: Laysan Island is the only island in the chain where the coverage has almost **no clouds**.
text_zh: 萊桑島（Laysan Island）是這一連串島嶼中唯一街景幾乎**沒有雲**的島嶼。

text: The French Frigate Shoals is a fairly long and thin island with a shabby-looking runway. The island has by far the **largest number of birds** out of all islands in the chain.
text_zh: 法屬弗igate礁（French Frigate Shoals）是一個相當長且薄的島嶼，有一條破舊的跑道。該島擁有這一連串島嶼中絕對**數量最多的鳥類**。

text: East Island is the **smallest** island in the chain. There is barely any vegetation and you can see the ocean in all directions.
text_zh: 東島（East Island）是這一連串島嶼中**最小的**島嶼。幾乎沒有任何植被，放眼望去各個方向都能看到海洋。

text: The western corner of the Midway Atoll runway is arguably the **most common location** on the official Geoguessr world map and may thus be worth remembering, particularly for a newer player.
text_zh: 中途島跑道的西角可以說是官方 Geoguessr 世界地圖上**最常見的地點**，因此可能值得記住，特別是對新手玩家而言。

text: Eastern Island, situated right next to the Midway Atoll, has two small areas of low-quality **tripod coverage**. It does not have any other official coverage.
text_zh: 東島（Eastern Island）緊鄰中途島，擁有兩個小範圍、低畫質的**三腳架街景**。它沒有其他官方街景。
